name: Foam and rubber
summary: Foam pads, rubber sheet, inner tubes, mats and seals for padding, sealing and insulating.
uses: Inner tube strips as heavy-duty rubber bands
identify: Mattresses and furniture, gym floor mats, carpet underlay, packing foam, car and bike inner tubes, conveyor belts, pipe lagging and fridge door seals. Closed-cell foam (camping mats, pool noodles) doesn’t soak up water; open-cell foam does. Burning foam gives off toxic smoke.
test: Squeeze and stretch it: good rubber springs back, old rubber cracks or goes sticky. Foam should spring back without crumbling.

decay.note: Rubber and foam harden, crack and crumble with heat and sunlight.
